title: The Forest That Talks in Light
hook: A single glowing mushroom can shine bright enough for you to read.
script: A single glowing mushroom can shine bright enough for you to read. Why would a fungus burn precious energy shining into the pitch black? It runs on the exact same acid found inside morning coffee. It even sets an internal timer. People assume the light is an accident, but it is an airport runway. The green beacon recruits passing beetles as taxis to spread its spores. What looks like quiet rot is actually an ecosystem talking in pure light.
